Your box’s WebView (Chromium %1$d) is outdated — if the video won’t play, select “Fix WebView”.

Streaming needs a modern WebView (Chromium 80 or newer). This box ships an outdated one, so videos can’t play here. This is usually fixable in a few minutes — a one-time update per box, no rooting needed.
1 · Press “Open download page” below (it opens this box’s browser). On the site, pick “Android System WebView 105.0.5195.136” — the newest release that still supports Android 6/7 boxes.
2 · Download the “%1$s” file variant for this box, open it when it finishes, allow installs from unknown sources when asked, and install.
3 · Come back here and press “Check again”. If it still shows the old number, fully reboot the box once.
All good — WebView is now Chromium %1$s. Videos should play. Enjoy!
